block.title: Slack Bot Token
block.text: Stores the Slack bot token (xoxb-...) used by "Send Notable to Slack (ES Findings)" (bin/notable_to_slack_json.py) for file_upload delivery to the #es-findings channel. Enter "slack_notable_action" for both Username and Realm below - this is the exact realm name notable_to_slack_json.py's param.slack_bot_token_realm already expects, so no further configuration is needed on the alert action itself. Leave blank and save nothing here if you plan to use webhook delivery instead, or param.slack_bot_token (plaintext) directly on the action.

block.title: Perplexity API Key
block.text: Stores the Perplexity API key used by "Send Notable to Perplexity API (Agentic Response)" (bin/notable_to_perplexity_json.py) to answer each notable's "perplexity_ask" block synchronously. Get a key at https://www.perplexity.ai/settings/api. Enter "perplexity_notable_action" for both Username and Realm below - this is the exact realm name notable_to_perplexity_json.py's param.perplexity_api_key_realm already expects, so no further configuration is needed on the alert action itself.
